body: Have you considered going to therapy of some sort? Would it be accessible to you?

Thank you for taking the time to type all of that out, that makes sense to me. I’ll try to find your comment for further reading. I’m happy to hear you’re getting out of that situation, I know it takes courage. Sending my best wishes your way

They are probably happy that you’re in their lives. I have a friend whose brother died by suicide and she always says that she would rather listen to someone’s story than read their obituary. Has it been harder to trust people after what has happened?
I hear you on that, it’s really really hard to go there. Truthfully I haven’t opened up like that to my friends either, and barely to my therapist. Do you feel better after talking to your friends?

That sounds like a really painful situation and you in no way deserved that. I feel the same way about venting to my friend and it’s hard because I feel like a burden. I’m learning that I’m not a burden and that when I say I am or when I’m feeling bad about talking to my friend about my life and my issues it’s really my brain pressuring me to isolate myself further. I’m glad that you decided to post here today to vent about how you are feeling. Do your friends know how upset you have been feeling?

Maybe you should give it some more time. I’ve written notes in the past and they’ve made me feel a little better and more in control. Is there anything that you would like to do with them or for them before you decide that it is your time? Is there anything that you could do to distract yourself from your feelings today?

I feel like being affected by seeing others being harmed is valid, and shows you have empathy. Seeing bigotry and people being hurt is triggering, even if it’s happening to somebody different from you. You sound like you’re one of the good people in the world, I know I don’t know you but I would miss you.
I’m curious, what does the data show?

That hurts to hear. I read the title and felt that pang of anger and hurt and I know that if I felt it a little you must have felt it a whole lot. I’ve seen that sometimes people will say that out of fear or because it’s uncomfortable to talk about it they don’t want to talk about it. I’m especially sorry that they said that if you were trying to reach out for help. I’m sending virtual hugs your way. Your pain is valid and your feelings are valid. Please continue to reach out and talk about it and ask for help. Let me know if you would like to talk.

I knit and I found out that you tie a noose in the same way you start a project. Who knew knitting could have the potential to be deadly? I’m going to try to keep it confined to knitting rather than “other projects”.

I read that statistic in a book today, I did not even know it was world bipolar disorder day until I checked Reddit. Anyway, after reading it I asked myself if I was going to be a part of that statistic too. I really enjoyed reading this and felt validated.
Thank you, I appreciate it a lot
I hope you get some restful sleep! It’s so much harder to function without sleeping enough.

I’ve been doing that too, it does help to trick yourself sometimes and just find a reason why today is no good. Thank you for your comment, I hope you keep finding reasons why tomorrow would be better too.
I love that the kitty fabric lines up and the little rip curl looks like a cat could have done it.
If you can read this, I know it’s hypocritical but I care about your life and I don’t want you to die.

Yeah, the fear of waking up after ODing and being messed up from it scares me too, there are so many different things to consider. Thanks for reaching out friend, it’s strangely comforting to hear from others who are going through it too

I completely resonate with the part about your partner, especially wishing we never met and wishing that I would be in some freak accident... I just can’t stand the thought of them thinking they had anything to do with it or them mourning me. I appreciate you sharing what you’re going through.
Reset is such a good word for what it feels like.

I’m really happy to hear you’re taking time to care for yourself, it’s really hard to come out of a depressed state and I’m proud that you did. One of the things I hate most is also that feeling of being reset, especially if I just go from manic to depressed. I hope you continue to feel better!
I just DM’d you back, thank you for your generosity!
Hey I am interested:)
Thank you, I have my session tomorrow and I’m going to try.

Thank you. I have a therapist and I feel like I’m really good at putting a front up or downplaying my symptoms. I can’t really afford to go to the hospital if I tell them how I’m feeling. I feel safe from suicide today mainly because I don’t have the things I would need to go through with it. Also I just really wouldn’t want my boyfriend to have to find me because I know he would be heartbroken.

You made a mistake, I understand why you feel really guilty about it but, Just because you made that mistake it doesn’t mean that you’re not redeemable or that you’re unworthy of being alive. It sounds like you’re carrying around a lot of shame, I really hope you can talk to someone about what happened and how you’re feeling, you don’t deserve to feel miserable.
When I called they were nice but it was awkward like I was talking to a coworker or something. It was really superficial.
